## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional Commit title (`feat(scope): imperative summary`)
- [ ] DCO sign-off on every commit (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Under 400 changed lines (excluding generated/lockfiles)
- [ ] CI passes locally (`lint`, `test`, `build`)
- [ ] No personal data, credentials or customer names in the diff
- [ ] ADR added or updated if this changes architecture, security, or data flow
- [ ] i18n: user-facing strings added in `lt`, `en`, and `ru`
- [ ] AI assistance noted in the description (if applicable)
